source_description: Canonical path-conditioned full-q MLP decoded with checkpoint x_mean/x_std and y_mean/y_std, followed by the repository adaptive sequential IK with previous accepted refined q as the primary seed and canonical MLP q as a retry seed. Full-pose IK enforces the fixed target RPY ('roll', 'pitch', 'yaw')=(3.1415926535897931,0,0) rad; orientation is represented as an XYZW quaternion using the quaternion_from_euler roll-pitch-yaw convention and checked with authoritative xMateCR7_link6 full-transform FK. The same FK enforces fixed target_z=0.32400000000000001 m with a non-weakening maximum Z-error gate of 0.001 m.
